title: Resolve Collided Component Json Migration Stragglers
description: The repo-wide `🔣️component.json` → `🔣️.json` filename-canonicalization migration (taxonomy statute: physicalLeafRendering.filename in 🧰️framework/🛍️products/🦑️repo/🔨️modules/📚️library/🔣️taxonomy.json, rendered by canonicalFilenamesForKind in 📚️library/🔍️discovery/🟦️.ts) skipped 330 directories where BOTH 🔣️.json and 🔣️component.json already existed (rename would have collided). Verified by sha256: the two files are NOT duplicates - same key set, different values. Task: for each of the 330 dirs (all under ✏️s/🔌️plugins/*/🗿️artifacts/*/🏅️standards/1/🪆️subsets/any/🧬️schema/🧬️mutations/*), determine which file is authoritative using evidence (which does the tooling actually read - grep mutationComponentFileKindId/canonicalFilenameForKind/descriptor-loading in 📜️script.ts and 📚️library; git log --date=iso timestamps on both files, never parsing commit message text since auto-commit dates are frozen fake strings; whether the sparse file is a uniform stub pattern from partial migration), then merge to one 🔣️.json per dir carrying the correct content and remove 🔣️component.json. Validate every result against the mutation descriptor derive rules (owner==dir path, dirname==<emoji><semanticKind>, semanticKind has a hyphen and equals kebab-case(aggregateVariant), verb in APPROVED_VERBS from 🧰️framework/🛍️products/💻️os/🔨️modules/📡️spr/🎮️command/🦀️component.rs). Do not touch frozen fixtures 🧫️fixtures/🧪️remaining-package-purity-authority/🔣️.json and 🧫️fixtures/🧪️cad-draw-path-projection/🔣️.json. Read-only git only, no worktrees, no modifying git commands.
summary: Resolved all 330 directories where the repo-wide component.json→.json canonicalization migration had collided (both files already existed). Evidence: taxonomy.json's mutationDescriptorFileKindId renders only 🔣️.json as canonical (never component.json); every component.json in the 330 was last touched by commit a8d1caf (2026-08-27, hand-authored real values); every colliding .json was a freshly-created generic scaffold stub from commit f7b265d (2026-08-28) or 67fb4216 (2026-09-01), confirmed blind by cross-checking requiredLanguageSurfaces against the actual filesystem (component.json matched fs in 307/330, the stub matched 0/330) and by displayName acronym casing (10 dirs: component.json has "Change URI"/"Remove AF Relationship", the stub has generic titlecase "Change Uri"/"Remove Af Relationship"). One field went the other way: payloadSchema in 23 stdio/pdf dirs, where component.json held a stale dotted-URN reference matching no file and the stub correctly named the real 🔣️.schema.json (confirmed as the repo-wide convention by sampling 1915 already-migrated descriptors elsewhere). Merge: component.json as base for all judgment fields, requiredLanguageSurfaces always recomputed from the filesystem, payloadSchema kept from whichever original value names a real file. All 330 merged descriptors validated 330/330 against parse_mutation_leaf_descriptor's rules in 🗣️dsl/✨️derive/🦀️.rs (exact 14 keys, owner==dir, semanticKind kebab, dirname/semanticKind match, kebab(aggregateVariant)==semanticKind, valid enums). 0 could not be decided. Full evidence, chronology and per-cluster reasoning in 📓️summary.md; working analysis/merge scripts kept under 📜️scripts/ for audit. Frozen fixtures (remaining-package-purity-authority, cad-draw-path-projection) were outside the 330-dir set and confirmed untouched via git status.
